entities.summary: Germain Muller, was a French playwright, poet, songwriter, actor, humourist, politician and a prominent figure in Alsatian culture. In 1946, he cofounded De Barabli, the most popular Alsatian language satirical cabaret. He was later elected a Strasbourg city councillor.
